description: This file defines the MergeStatuses class, which represents the result of remote shuffle block merge operations in Apache Spark's network shuffle protocol. It includes fields for shuffle ID, merge ID, bitmaps of merged blocks, reducer IDs, and sizes of merged partitions. It provides methods for encoding/decoding, equality, hashing, and string representation.
